sources.title: minhtoan/gpt2-vietnamese · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GPT-2, a language pretrained model with a causal language modeling (CLM) goal, is a transformer-based language model. This model was pre-trained and used to generate text on the Vietnamese Wikilingua dataset.

sources.title: NlpHUST/gpt2-vietnamese - AI Model Zoo - BimAnt
sources.snippet: The model was trained on Vietnamese Oscar dataset (32 GB) to optimize a traditional language modelling objective on v3-8 TPU for around 6 days. It reaches around 13.4 perplexity on a chosen validation set from Oscar.
